title: Barry Silbert Sees Latest Slump As 'Gift From Crypto Gods,' Drops His Top Bets Even As Bitcoin Sinks Under $75,000
text: Barry Silbert, CEO of cryptocurrency conglomerate Digital Currency Group, described the latest cryptocurrency crash as a god-sent opportunity poised to trigger significant capital inflows back into the sector. Why Silbert Sees Opportunity Amid Chaos In an X post, Silbert referred to the market slump as a “gift from the crypto gods,” suggesting that it is clearing out excess leverage and “crap tokens.” “A massive capital rotation into crypto is about to begin.
